name: @dxkjailbreak/dsh-trace-vault
description: Process vault for the nine security presets + dxkjailbreak: zero-touch capture of every tool call (tool/call + tool/result paired by callId) into a local SQLite store with outcome classification (ok / blocked / error), plus model-side trace_search / trace_get / trace_recent tools — cross-compaction process memory and the failure-attribution data plane. Security-mode sessions only; capture never intercepts or rewrites; stored text is capped (index, not archive). Adds the failure-attribution envelope: a systemPrompt context block renders a blocked-aggregation hint (403/WAF/429 cluster) per assembly, change-only delivery, security modes only. v0.2.1: result text extraction handles the real pipeline nested tool-result blocks (text lives in the inner content array), found by live-model probing. v0.3.1: merged single-card mode dxkjailbreak registered in MODE_IDS; composedPreset object form normalized; non-security sessions no longer fall back to redteam.
author: dxk
